name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, July 18, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 20, 2017.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for the Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for the Parks & Recreation Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
May Treasurer Report
ACTION: That the May report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Accept Public Improvements for Tract No. 71769 (Cypress Project)
ACTION: That the City Council accept the public improvements constructed by the developer for the Cypress Pointe subdivision, Tract No. 71769; and approve exoneration of all related bonds and securities related to the construction of said public improvements.
Item #7j
k.
Ord No. 790 - An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, amending Section 2-101 of the Lomita Municipal Code to clarify that when scheduled City Council Meetings fall on a legal holiday, the meeting shall be held on the next succeeding business day thereafter, which is not a holiday. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7k
l.
Transfer of $48,949 from the Museum Expansion Fund to the Railroad Museum Foundation General Maintenance Account for various upgrades and restoration projects at the Museum
ACTION: That following the direction of the Council, the Railroad Museum Board is recommending the allocation of funds in the amount of $48,949 from the Museum Expansion Fund to the FY 2017-18 Railroad Museum Foundation General Maintenance Account (720-750-5705.000) for various upgrades and restoration projects at the Museum.
Item #7l
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF AN INSPECTION SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH LOS ANGELES COUNTY DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH FOR MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS ACTION: That the matter be continued off calendar.
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
9.
PUBLIC HEARING - AN APPEAL OF THE CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL FOR A SPECIAL ENTERTAINMENT PERMIT FOR THE BUSINESS AT 24123 NARBONNE AVE. (THE ALEHOUSE) ACTION: At the applicant's request, the hearing is being continued off calendar.
10.
PUBLIC HEARING - AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 6 OF TITLE V RELATED TO GRAFFITI PREVENTION AND REMOVAL ACTION: That the matter be continued off calendar.
11.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Mary Kojima to the Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, August 1, 2017, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
